data.long_meaning: A girl named Nezma means 'a star' in Arabic, Urdu, and Pashto languages. It is derived from the word 'Nezam' which means 'order' or 'system'. Nezma represents beauty, brightness, and enlightenment. It is a perfect name for a baby girl born under the night sky. The name Nezma carries the meaning “A Star” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Nezma usually hope their child will grow to embody a star and live with faith, good character and purpose.
